name: stripe_mcp
summary: Stripe REST API connector — fiat onramp for the dApp and product subscriptions. Stdlib-only (no `stripe` python SDK dep). Bearer-auth via STRIPE_SECRET_KEY resolved through studio/auth/keys.upstream_key('stripe'). Every successful call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='monetization', model='stripe', scope=f'stripe_<tool>'. Stripe-issued IDs and amounts are preserved in the record for downstream reconciliation. Webhook receiver verifies HMAC over Stripe-Signature with a 5-minute timestamp window.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring blender_mcp shape. SERVICE='stripe'. Uses form-encoded urllib POST to api.stripe.com/v1/*. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). Smoke-validates connection via GET /v1/balance (free, no charge).

env_vars.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: HMAC secret for verifying inbound webhook signatures
env_vars.STRIPE_LIVE_MODE: set to 1 to allow live keys; default 0 forces test-mode safeguards

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful tool call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='monetization'
Stdlib-only — no `stripe` python package required; uses urllib with form-encoded POST
Replay-safe — webhook receiver enforces 5-min timestamp window + HMAC signature verification
Graceful — if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing, connect() returns False and send() emits SendResult(success=False, error='stripe_not_connected')
Live-mode gated — production keys flagged via STRIPE_LIVE_MODE=1 env (TEXT-PLACEHOLDER for explicit confirm-prompt)
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.stripe_mcp import StripeMCPConnector
c = StripeMCPConnector()
c.connect()
r = c.send('create_payment_intent', '{"amount_cents":99900,"currency":"usd","description":"realestate_walkthrough_999"}')
print(r.metadata['stripe_id'], r.crystal_id)
